# MH-13 — Change a reservation

**Business value:** 920

[Back to index](../README.md)

## User story

As an employee

I want to modify the details of a reservation

So that I can manage last minute issues


## Notes

It should be possible to:
- rearrange people across tables (e.g. to make room after a cancelation)
- add new people to a party
- change / add dietary restrictions or allergies
